verdict.rationale: Apify documents building custom Actors with its own SDK toolkits, CLI scaffolding (`apify create`), Docker base images and support for common scraping frameworks, and it describes moving existing projects onto the platform. However, the pack never shows the actual deploy/push step or states that the platform runs Actors serverlessly without user-managed infrastructure, so the 'deploy without managing infrastructure' half is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documented deploy/push workflow, explicit serverless/no-infrastructure-management evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of deploying custom Actors.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure
